results.question: What is the average product price in each category? Show the category name and average price in kopecks, rounded to the nearest integer.
results.initial_sql:
SELECT 
    c.name AS category_name,
    ROUND(AVG(p.price_cents)) AS average_price_kopecks
FROM 
    products p
JOIN 
    categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
GROUP BY 
    c.name
ORDER BY 
    average_price_kopecks ASC, c.name ASC;
results.final_sql:
SELECT 
    c.name AS category_name,
    ROUND(AVG(p.price_cents)) AS average_price_kopecks
FROM 
    products p
JOIN 
    categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
GROUP BY 
    c.name
ORDER BY 
    average_price_kopecks ASC, c.name ASC;

results.question: How many units of stock are there in each category? Show the category name and total quantity.

GROUP BY 
    c.category_id, c.name
ORDER BY

results.final_sql:
SELECT 
    c.name AS category_name,
    SUM(p.stock_quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM 
    categories c
LEFT JOIN 
    products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
GROUP BY 
    c.category_id, c.name
ORDER BY 
    c.name ASC;

    SELECT
        oi.order_id,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents) AS total_value_cents

)

LIMIT 5;

results.question: What is the average rating of products from each supplier? Show the supplier name and rating, rounded to two decimal places.
results.initial_sql:

    s.name AS supplier_name,
    ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS average_rating
FROM 
    suppliers s
JOIN 
    products p ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id
JOIN 
    reviews r ON p.product_id = r.product_id
GROUP BY 
    s.supplier_id, s.name
results.final_sql:

    s.name AS supplier_name,
    ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS average_rating
FROM 
    suppliers s
JOIN 
    products p ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id
JOIN 
    reviews r ON p.product_id = r.product_id
GROUP BY 
    s.supplier_id, s.name

results.question: How many distinct customers purchased products from each category in delivered orders? Show the category name and customer count.
results.initial_sql:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT order_id
    FROM shipments
    WHERE status = 'delivered'
)
SELECT c.name AS category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customer_count
FROM categories c
JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM delivered_orders)
GROUP BY c.category_id;
results.final_sql:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT order_id
    FROM shipments
    WHERE status = 'delivered'
)
SELECT c.name AS category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customer_count
FROM categories c
JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM delivered_orders)
GROUP BY c.category_id;

results.question: How many orders were placed in each month of 2025? Show the month in YYYY-MM format and the count.

    strftime('%Y-%m', ordered_at) AS order_month, 
    COUNT(*) AS order_count 
FROM 
    orders 
WHERE 
    ordered_at LIKE '2025-%' 
GROUP BY 
    order_month 
ORDER BY 
    order_month ASC;
